tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad gdab pa'i cho ga'i mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa las nyung ngur bsdus pa dri med lam 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad gdab pa'i cho ga'i mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa las nyung ngur bsdus pa dri med lam 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad gdab pa'i cho ga'i mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa las nyung ngur bsdus pa dri med lam 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs gnyis mthar phyin rgyal ba'i gtsug tor las// grol ba bzhi ldan phyag rgyar shar ba'i lha// rgyud dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba ston mdzad pa// zhi 'tsho brgyud par bcas la gus phyag 'tshal// ring bsrel snying po can gyi gdung*// bden par gsungs pas rab bsngags pa// rnam dag cho gas bsgrub pa'i tshul// bsdus te bya ba'i rim pa 'chad// gang dag sā tstsha 'bum phrag la sogs pa grangs mang du 'debs pa'i tshe/ mchod rten brgya rtsa gdab pa'i cho ga rgyas 'bring tshar mang du mi lcogs pas zor yangs su bya bar 'dod na/ cho ga la mi gtogs pa'i sbyor ba bsham gyi rim pa rgyas 'bring gi phyag len ltar byas nas/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga la gsum/ tshogs zhing nye bar sgrub pa/ yan lag bcus tshogs bsags shing gzungs bzla// bsags sbyong sogs kyis mjug bsdu ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos so// dang po lnga/ bzhugs gsol bdag mdun mchod rdzas bsgrub// rig pa chen mos byin brlab bo// dang po ni/ mchod rten rnams dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag pa'i tshe/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha stu be swā hā/ bdag gzhan don gnyis phun tshogs spyod gyur cig /oṃ badzra padma sa ma ye swā hā/ rdo rje padma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ nam mkha' sa gzhi rgya mtsho'i mjing thams cad// mchod rten rnam pa mang pos gang bar gyur// gnyis pa bdag sgrub pa ni/ bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skur gsal ba'i// snying gar zla steng rdo rje rtse lnga las// ye shes 'od zer sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor 'phros// lus kyi nang gang ba spu'i bu ga nas// nam mkha'i mthar khyab 'gro khams byin gyis brlabs// don mdzad slar 'dus sku yi nang thim gyur// gnyis pa mdun rten sgrub pa ni/ dkyil 'khor steng du yi ge raṃ dmar po/ hūm̐ raṃ swā hā/ de las me 'bar gnas kyi rtog pa sbyangs// ye shes rin chen lnga ldan dkyil 'khor gyur// pad steng ling tshe rnams su a dkar po// oṃ a tsand+ra maṇḍal hūm̐ phaṭa/

a yig yongs gyur zla gdan re rer gyur// oṃ badzra dhā tu a dhi tiṣṭha hūm̐/ rin chen gzhal yas chos kyi dbyings mnyam nang*// dag gsal ye shes lnga las grub pa yi// mchod rten rnams kyi bum pa'i dbus nyid du// dri med snying po gser gyi mdog can dang*// phyogs bzhi dbus lngar de bzhin gshegs pa lnga// sa bon lnga gsal ye shes 'od lnga 'phros// bde gshegs sku yi sprin gyis nam mkhar khyab// 'jig rten khams kun dag pa'i zhing du bsgyur// 'gro don mdzad nas slar 'dus thugs kar zhugs// phrin las sgrib dag rdo rje gsum du gyur// bzhi pa mchod rdzas bsgrub pa ni/ oṃ sarba pū dza puṣpe swā hā/ kun bzang mchod sprin rgya chen zad med pas// mchod rten re re bzhin du mchod par gyur// spos chu'i steng du a las zla dkyil las// 'od 'phros spos chu ye shes bdud rtsir gyur// mchod yon gyi phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ a mṛ te arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ 'phags pa thams cad mnyes par gyur cig /phyag rgya rgya mtsho'i sprin phung dbu gtsug nas// bkram ste ye shes sku yi nang du 'dus// phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang rnams bskur bar gyur// lnga pa rig pa chen mo'i byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ trai ya dhwe sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya garbhe/ dzwa la dharma dhā tu ga rbhe/ sam̐ ha ra ṇa ā yuḥsam̐ sho dha ya/ pā pam̐ sarba ta thā ga ta sa manta u ṣṇī ṣa bi ma le bi shuddhe swā hā/ 'jig rten khams kun mchod rten rang bzhin gyur// oṃ trai ya dhwe sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya garbhe/ dzwa la dharma dhā tu garbhe/ sam̐ ha ra ṇa ā yuḥsam̐ sho dha ya/ pā pam̐ sarba ta thā ga ta sa manta u ṣṇī ṣa bi ma le bi shuddhe ma hā bi ra dze ra gambhīr si dharma dhā tu garbhe/ bi bi sā ra a a laṃ swā hā/ sa gzhi thams cad mchod rten rang bzhin gyur// oṃ trai ya dhwe sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya garbhe/

dzwa la dharma dhā tu ga rbhe/ sam̐ ha ra ṇa ā yuḥsam̐ sho dha ya/ pā pam̐ sarba ta thā ga ta sa manta/ bi ma la uṣṇī ṣa bi shuddhe/ mahā bi ra dze ra gambhīr si/ dharma dhā tu bi bi sā ra a ma ma ki swā hā/ chu mtsho kun kyang mchod rten rang bzhin gyur// oṃ trai ya dhwe sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya garbhe/ dzwa la dharma dhā tu ga rbhe/ sam̐ ha ra ṇa ā yuḥsam̐ sho dha ya/ pā pam̐ sarba ta thā ga ta sa manta/ bi ma la uṣṇī ṣa bi shuddhe/ mahā bi ra dze ra gambhīr si/ dharma dhā tu bi bi sā ra a ma ma ki swā hā/ nam mkha'i khams kun mchod rten rang bzhin gyur// oṃ ratna tsaitye pañtsa ye bi bi sā ra swā hā/ lan gsum/ rin chen sna lnga las grub mchod pa'i rten// tshad dpag med pas 'jig rten gang gyur cig / ces pa rnams brjod cing don yid la bya'o// sbyor ba 'di rnams ni shes pas grub pa las gsungs pa ste da lta gzhung nyid tshad mar byed pas phan yon la bsams nas bkod pa yin cing*/ mkhan po'i cho ga gzhung du mi gtogs pas 'di yan chad ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon med do// gnyis pa tshogs rten sgrub pa'i thog mar phyogs bcu'i 'phags pa rnams mngon sum lta bur dmigs nas phyag 'tshal ba'i gzungs bcas phyag lan gsum byas te 'khod/ cho ga dngos la/ sems bskyed gnas yo byin gyis brlab/ spyan 'dren phyag mchod bzhugs gsol khrus/ zhes rnam grangs bdun yod pa las/ dang po ni/ chos thams cad dmigs su med pa'i stong pa nyid do// zhes brjod la mnyam par bzhag /'phags pa rnams kyis de kho na nyid thugs su chud pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i go 'phang brnyes la/ sems can rnams kyis de bzhin nyid ma rtogs pas mtha' med pa'i 'khor bar sdug bsngal sha stag gis nyen pa'i 'gro ba de dag bdag gi pha mar ma gyur pa 'ga' yang med cing*/ bdag gis kyang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas 'gro ba bsgral bar dam bcas pas de rnams yal bar 'dor ba ni mi rigs pas/

'di dag sdug bsngal las 'don/ bde ba la 'god par bya'o snyam du byams pa dang snying rje drag tu bsgom/ 'on kyang da lta bdag lta bus 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che sgrub par mi nus pas gtsug tor dri ma med pa' ི ('phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa'i ) gzungs kyi cho ga la brten te 'phags pa rnams kyi mthu dang byin gyis rlabs kyis 'gro ba rnams la phan pa bsgrub par byas la/ bdag nyid dbang thob nas gzhan dring mi 'jog par thabs mkhas pa'i sgo sna tshogs kyis sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba bla na med par bsgrub par bya'o snyam du bsams la/ sangs rgya chos tshogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs brjod la tshad med bzhi'i ting 'dzin bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis/ deng kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri med par snang ba ('phags pa 'od zer dri med rnam par dag pa ) de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dang dam tshig la rnam par lta ba'i gzungs kyi mdo las byung ba'i cho ga bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku'i mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad (dgu bcu go dgu) gdab pa'i gnas 'dir/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa dang*/ 'phags pa chos skyong ba thams cad gang na 'dzom pa'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor dang mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba 'di rnams/ ji ltar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can gyis bsgrubs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan dang ldan par gyur te/ phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i sa gzhi la/

bkod pa thams cad las 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkod pa la brten pa'i rin po che'i gzhal med khang chen por gyur pa'i dbus su padma'i gdan/ rin po che seng ge'i khri'i steng na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi sku'i mchod rten rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa che ba'i yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i bdag nyid grangs med pa zhig rom mer dkrigs par gyur pa'i mtha' 'khor bar gzhal med khang chen po'i nang du 'phags pa rnams gdan 'dzoms pa'i gdan khri so so'i smon lam khyad par can gyi mnga' thang dang mtshams par grub pa mdzes pa sha stag 'byung bar gyur cig /phyi nang kun tu'ang cha rigs dang mtshams par lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa/ zhal zas dang na bza' dang*/ rgyan dang rol mo la sogs pa phul du phyin pa sna tshogs pa/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis bkang zhing rgyan klubs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /'phags pa thams cad gdan 'dzoms nas/ de bzhin du byin gyis rlabs shing bzhes te longs spyod par gyur cig / ces lan gsum gyis gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin brlab/ yang dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis de bzhin du gyur cig / ces lan gsum gyis thun mong du byin gyis brlab bo// gsum pa ni/ pus mo btsugs/ thal mo sbyar te/ 'dun pa rtse gcig pas/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu na dus gsum du bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dgongs su gsol/ thugs rje chen po dang*/

byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' zhing*/ 'gro ba'i don du smon lam khyad par can mdzad pa las glengs te/ bdag sogs 'gro ba mang po bskyab pa'i slad du mgon skyabs su gsol nas spyan 'dren cing mchis na/ mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzoms pa chen po mdzad de byin gyis brlab par ci gnang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ 'phags pa rang rgyal dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos chen po'i sku gdung ring bsrel dang*/ sku gdung gi mchod rten dang*/ chos kyi sku'i mchod rten gzugs kyi tshul du rnam par bzhag pa byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum dang*/ bsrung ba med pa gsum dang*/ bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos nyid dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ stobs bcu dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad dang*/ thugs rje chen po dang*/ ye shes la sogs pa yon tan bsags pa'i mchod rten dang*/ chos kyi dbyings dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ 'phags pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa lumba'i tshal du sku bltams pa'i mchod rten la sogs te/ phyogs bcu thams cad na mchod rten khyad par can 'khor dang bcas pa ji snyed bzhugs pa thams cad/ chos kyi dbyings dang rigs thams cad na bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa thams cad mnyes par bgyi ba dang*/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi bsod nams spel ba'i slad du/ deng dkon mchog gsum dang mchod rten khyad par can 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa'i gnas su byin gyis brlabs pa 'dir/ mchod par 'os pa'i bde ba sbyar ba thams cad kyis bstabs shing spyan 'dren gyis/ mthu stobs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis rnam par 'phrul pa mdzad de/ chos kyi dbyings kun tu 'gro ba'i tshul gyis gshegs shing bzhes par gsol lo//

zhes dang*/ mchod rten mchod gnas dpal ldan pa// sku gdung chos sku chos dbyings dang*// rig sngags gsang sngags snying po dang*// phyag rgya byin rlabs gshegs su gsol// gshegs 'byon skye 'grib med pa'i sku// ji ltar smon bzhin yod pa dag /dkyil 'khor 'char ba'i tshul bzhin du// 'jig rten skyabs phyir gshegs su gsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// mchod rten khyad par 'khor gtogs pa// 'og min gnas dang lha tshogs dang*// bsam gtan bzhi dang 'dod khams drug /sde brgyad tshogs dang 'byung po kun// dam tshig can dang thugs dam can// tshangs pa brgya byin rgyal chen bzhi// phyogs skyong gza' dang rgyu skar dang*// dkon mchog mthong thos skyabs brten pa// phyag bgyi thal mo sbyar 'os shing*// mgos gtugs mchod dang kun sbyin dang*// rab tu sbyin 'os kun gshegs shig / ces rol mo'i sgra dang spos dud bcas spyan drangs pas/ 'phags pa'i tshogs phyogs bcu nas gshegs te 'khor dang bcas pa gdan la bzhugs par gyur par mos/ bzhi pa bsu phyag ni/ dge 'dun rnams 'grengs nas phyag lan bdun 'tshal te/ ye shes tshogs kyis bskyed pa'i sku// ming dang gzugs las rnam par grol// rtog dang spros las rab 'das kyang*// bsnyel ba mi mnga'i rang bzhin can// dngos dang dngos med mtha' las dben// bsam brjod yul las shin tu 'das// ye shes rnams kyi gnas gyur pa// rnam dag sku la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams tshogs kyis bskyed pa'i sku// dbang phyug chen po'i gnas mchog na// chos la mnga' mdzad longs spyod pa// byang chub sems dpa' yongs kyi mgon// gtsang ma'i gnas nas ma g.yos pa// gdul bya'i bsam pa ci bzhin du// 'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas par// sprul mang 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod// skad cig thang cig yud tsam la// dga' ldan mchog nas babs pa dang*// 'jig rten sgyu rtsal phul byung zhing*// bdud bcom byang chub 'tshang rgya ste// 'khor lo bskor nas 'das pa'i bar// cho 'phrul gcig char so sor ston// cho 'phrul ngo mtshar rmad byung ba// lha yi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// ston pa mchog bzhugs gzhal med khang*// dbyibs legs rnam par phye bas mdzes// kha dog sna tshogs spel legs su// rin chen 'bar ba mang pos brgyan// yid 'ong nyams dga' lha yi gnas// rgyan bkod dkyil na mdzes pa la// 'phags pa mchod pa'i rten bgyis te// ston pa 'khor dang bcas la bstod//

lnga pa bsu ba'i mchod pa ni/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga ba te badzra sā ra pra mardha ne ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre mahā badzre ma hā te dzo badzre/ ma hā bidyā badzre/ ma hā bo dhi maṇḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badzre/ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha na badzre swā hā/ zhes bzla zhing*/ mchod pa dri med yongs dag pa// rnam mang rgya che thams cad dang*// so so'i mnga' thang rgya chen du// 'os pa'i bde bar sbyar ba 'bul// zhes pas mchod pa bzang zhing rgya che bar dmigs te 'bul lo// drug pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ sku gdung chos sku byang chub phyogs// ma 'dres bsrung med bsnyel mi mnga'// mi 'jigs stobs dang sangs rgyas chos// rdo rje ye shes tshogs bsags pa// chos dbyings rig sngags gsang sngags dang*// snying po phyag rgya byin rlabs kyis// mchod rten khyad par ji snyed dang*// dpal ldan bsod nams zhing mchog kun// chos don dag pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// rin chen stegs dang khri 'phang dang*// gtsang gdangs lha rdzas padma la// mi gnas tshul gyis gdan la bzhugs// badzra ā sa na tiṣṭhantu/

bdun pa khrus gsol ba ni/ phyogs bzhi'i bum pa dang chu bo rnam lngas sku khrus phul la/ ji ltar me long gzugs brnyan snang gyur kyang*// chos dbyings dag pa'i sku la bskyod pa med// rin chen lnga las grub pa'i mchod rten dang*// sa'am chu'am 'on te bar snang la// sems can don du rin chen skur bstan pa// mchod rten dmigs par bcas te sku khrus gsol// khams gsum gnas pa'i bag chags dag gyur cig /phyogs bzhir bzhugs pa'i rigs mchog rnam pa bzhi'i// chos kyi sku la ye shes khrus gsol bas// khams gsum 'khor ba'i nyon mongs skyon bral nas// legs pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs par shog /sku mchog rnam dag blta bas mi ngoms la// ngo mtshar skyon bral mkha' dbyings nyi gsal 'dra// chos kyi sku la dri ma mi mnga' yang*// sri zhu bkur sti rim gro'i tshul tsam du// chu gtsang sman skol 'o ma 'dag chal chus// gus pa'i yid kyis sku khrus 'di gsol bas// 'gro ba'i lus sems sdug bsngal nad bsal te// nyes pa'i skyon bral 'gro ba'i yid 'ong ba// dam pa'i sku mchog bdag gis thob par shog / ces smon lam re re'i mthar/ oṃ sarba tathā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes btags te bkru'o// de nas ras kha tshar ma nyams pas phyi zhing*/ bde gshegs sku gzugs dpe dang mtshan mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don du gzugs sku cir yang gda'// rin chen dbyig ltar nyes pa'i skyon bral yang*// 'jig rten sri zhu gus pa'i tshul tsam du// sdig med rgyal ba rnams kyis rab bsngags pa'i// ras mchog 'di yis rgyal ba'i sku phyis pas// nyon mongs dug gsum sgrib pa kun byang nas// sku gsum ngang du bdag cag 'gyur bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes phyi'o// gnyis pa yan lag bcu'i tshogs bsags shing gzungs bzla ba la bcu gcig /phyag 'tshal mchod bshags yi rang bskul// gsol 'debs skyabs sems bsngo ba dang*// 'dod gsol gzungs sngags bzla ba'o// de la dang po phyag 'tshal ba ni/

ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu na dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur pa/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dkon mchog bla na med pa thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo// skyabs su mchi'o// de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis legs par gsungs pa/ legs par bsgrubs pa/ legs par thugs su chud pa/ dam pa'i chos dkon mchog bla na med pa thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo// skyabs su mchi'o// ston pa bcom ldan 'das de dag gi thugs kyi sras sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po thams cad dang*/ ston pa bde bar gshegs pa de dag gi gsung gi sras 'phags pa rang rgyal dang 'phags pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun te/ tshogs kyi mchog bla na med pa thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo// skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu na mchod rten ring bsrel dang sku gdung dang bcas pa thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo// skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo// skyabs su mchi'o// sku gdung phra mor bsil ba'i ring bsrel snod// rgyud dang 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos kyi tshul// sems can rnams kyis mchod par bya ba'i rten// chos sku'i rten du bzhag la phyag 'tshal bstod// rang bzhin rnam dag chos dbyings de bzhin nyid// spros pa'i dri mas ma gos dkar ba la// rin chen spras pas mtshan mchog rdzogs pa'i sku// 'gro don legs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// de bzhin sku gdung dbyibs bcas chos sku dag /gang gis mthong thos dran nam reg kyang rung*// mtho ris dpal dang thar mchog bde thob pa// yon tan sna tshogs mnga' la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku bltams rab byung byang chub bdud tshogs btul// chos 'khor dbyen zlum cho 'phrul lha las babs// byin rlabs myang 'das ring bsrel bzhi bzhugs sogs// bde gshegs mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang*// phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su yang*// skur bcas skur ni med pa yi// mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag byar 'os pa

sogs brjod la phyag bya'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/ chos skyong mchod pa'o// dang po la mchod yul bzung ba ni/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga ba te badzra sā ra pra mardha ne ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre mahā badzre ma hā te dzo badzre/ ma hā bidyā badzre/ ma hā bo dhi maṇḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badzre/ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha na badzre swā hā/ lan gsum brjod la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams dang dam pa'i chos// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs// tshad med bzhi dngos rin chen bzhi las grub// rigs bzhi'i mchod rten rnams la mchod pa 'bul// lho phyogs 'dzam gling rin chen la sogs na// bzhugs pa'i phyogs bzhi'i mchod rten rnam bzhi sogs// byang chub phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang*// rgyal ba'i ma 'dres yon tan kun bsags pa'i// chos kyi sku yi mchod rten khyad par can// phyogs bcu kun na bzhugs la mchod pa 'bul// dad brtson shugs kyis lus ngag sems btud de// brtson 'grus drag pos rin chen sna lnga dang*// 'byung ba lnga las grub pa'i mchod rten dang*// sku gdung ring bsrel rnams la mchod pa 'bul// rdo ring them skas chu srin rgyal mtshan dang*// gdugs dang ba dan dar gyi cod pan dang*// padma nyi zla sil snyan lha rdzas kyis// tshangs pa'i dbyangs ldan dmigs pa dag par mchod// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthus bsgyur ba// yon chab dag pa mar me dri chab dang*// me tog dam pa bshos gtsang mnyes pa'i mchog /mchod yon rnam lnga'i tshogs kyis mnyes par bgyi// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul pa yi// 'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten grub pa'i rdzas/ kun bzang rnam dag mchod pa'i sprin phung gis// nam mkha' gang bar dmigs te mchod par bgyi// srid gsum 'khor ba'i 'dam las drangs pa dang*// 'gro don mdzad pa'i thugs dam skong slad du// ye shes nyi mas mtshan ma'i skyon spangs te// byams pa'i thugs rjes mchod pa bzhes su gsol//

mchod yon 'bul ba ni phyogs bzhi'i bzed zhal du mchod yon sbrengs la/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rdzogs// bla na med dang yid las grub// rang bzhin sprul dang gzugs brnyan sogs// ngo mtshar dpal yon bsam mi khyab// thugs rje byin rlabs rmad po che// mchod pa'i rten gyur gang bzhugs la// bkra shis dpal tshogs gzhal yas 'dir// bla med mchod pa'i rgyun bshams nas// chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin du// argha'i rgyun yang mi 'chad de// bkra shis mchod pa 'di 'bul na// thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol// bye brag tu 'bul ba ni/ bde gshegs rnams kyis longs spyod kyi// kun bzang mchod pas rol mdzad kyang*// 'gro ba'i mun pa bsal slad du// bkur sti rim gro'i tshul tsam du// bla med mchod pa rnam lnga 'di// 'gro ba'i don du 'bul lags na// mchod pa'i sprin gyis khyab gyur nas// bsod nams gter chen thob par shog / ces pas nyer spyod lnga 'bul/ bde gshegs sku mchog mtshan dang dpe byad ldan// byang chub mchog gi rgyan gyis mdzes lags kyang*// rin chen do shal se mo do la sogs// rgyan gyi khyad par brgya phrag mang po dang*// dri zhim na bza' sna tshogs dbul bar bgyi// zhes rgyan dang na bza' 'bul/ theg mchog bla bre gdugs dang ba dan sgreng*// bdud bcom rgyal mtshan lhab lhub dar 'phan dang*// gar dang rol mo mchod pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzes par brgyan par shog / ces rol mo'i khyad par du mas mchod/ de nas zhal zas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin brlabs la/ rgyal ba'i sku la bkres skyems mi mnga' yang*// bdag cag bsod nams zhing du 'gyur slad du// bshos dang zhal zas sbyar ba 'di 'bul bas// dus kun dge ba'i lo tog 'phel rgyas nas// bde ba can du padma las skyes te// ting 'dzin chos dang zas la spyod par shog

/ ces 'bul/ bde gshegs mgon po dpag bsam 'khor dang bcas// bsod nams ye shes sku lnga mthar phyin pa// chos kyi longs spyod bkur sti'i tshul tsam du// 'bru lnga spos lnga sman lnga rin chen lnga// snying po lnga bcas rgyal bas rab bsngags pa// bdag gzhan don gyi snying po 'di phul bas// 'gro la phan phyir tshul khrims mchog ldan te// rin chen gter ltar kun la phan 'dogs shog / ces lnga phrag lnga 'bul/ de nas rten 'brel snying pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i yungs kar 'thor zhing*/ bde gshegs kun bzang mngon par sangs rgyas te// rdo rje gdan la mngon par bzhugs pa na// dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin gyis gus bcas pas// sngags grub rgyal po yungs kar phul ba ltar// deng 'dir ston pas bdud bzhi tshar bcad nas// skye rga na 'chi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// bdag dang mtha' yas 'gro ba kun bsgral nas// rdo rje gdan la mngon par 'tshang rgya shog / bkra shis kyi rdzas 'bul/ bde gshegs kun bzang mthong bas bkra shis ltar// rgyal ba 'khor bcas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /ngan sdig log pa'i tshogs rnams bcom gyur nas// rgyal sras ting 'dzin tshogs rnams 'phel dar zhing*// zhal mthong tsam gyis bde ba'i mchog brnyes nas// nyi ltar zhal dro zla ltar 'od gsal zhing*// bdag dang 'gro la zhal dro byin che nas// bskal pa'i mthar thug bar du bzhugs su gsol// zhes mnga' dbul/ de nas spyan dbye ba'i smon lam gsol ba ni/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag cag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku'i gzugs brnyan bzhengs su gsol te/ mchod par 'os pa'i bde bar sbyar ba thams cad kyis mchod cing bkur bas/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal te/ de dang de dag phul ba las thob pa'i yon tan khyad par can thams cad ma lus pa thob par gyur cig

/rten 'di yang 'jig rten ji srid kyi bar du mchod pa'i rten du bzhugs nas phyogs dus thams cad du bkra shis shing byin che bar gyur cig /rgyal ba'i ring bsrel mchod 'os bla med rnams// spyan drangs phyag bgyis bstod dang bkur ba'i mthus// sngon bsags las kyi sgrib pa kun byang nas// 'gro drug tshogs rdzogs mngon par 'tshang rgya shog / ces brjod la me tog 'thor ro// gnyis pa ni/ rang byung 'dren pa dpa' bo lha yi lha// bcom ldan shāka thub sku gdung ring bsrel snod// 'jig rten gsum gyi mchod gnas mchog bzhugs pa// chos bzang rnam snang rnam pa thams cad zhal// gzugs kyi khyad par lta bas mi ngoms khyod// ye shes tshogs rdzogs chos kyi sku lags te// rnam rtog bral bas yon tan kun gyi gzhi// byang chub phyogs chos shes bcu stobs bcu sogs// 'di 'dra'i dam chos ngo mtshar rmad rnams kyis// thabs mkhas thugs rjes mchod rten tshul du sprul// nam mkha'i khams la tshon bkye ji bzhin du// yon tan khyad par kha dog dbyibs su bsgyur// dpal gnas rin chen 'byung gnas chen po pa// dus gsum rgyal ba'i mchod rten sku gdung tshul// dpal 'byung ka niṣka dang rab byung tshul// bsod nams phung pos yul khams byin chags shing*// sangs rgyas sprul pa phrin las rdzogs par mdzad// sa bcu'i rgyal tshab byams pa'i gtsug gi rgyan// dkon mchog gsum gyi bdag nyid chen po la// ri lung nags tshal chu klung mkhar gnas pa'i// lha tshogs dad pas gnam sa kun nas dkrigs// sdom brtson rgyal sras 'khor bzhi khyim bdag dang*// dbus mtha'i rgyal khams mi tshogs kun 'dus nas// me tog phreng ba spel legs mdzes pa dang*// tsandan dri bshos mar me rol mor bcas// bkra shis glu dbyangs bstod pa'i rnam pa dang*// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan lhab lhub brgyan// lus ngag yid gsum dad pas bstod par bgyi//

gsum pa gtor 'bul la/ zlum gtor gsum bshams la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyed par gyur/ a kā ro sogs gsum brjod pas byin brlab/ oṃ dhriṣṭa rā ṣṭā ya swā hā/ oṃ ba ru ḍhe kā ya swā hā/ oṃ ba rū pākṣa ya swā hā/ oṃ be shra ba ṇā ya swā hā/ rnams kyi mthar a kā ro btags pas phul la/ zab cing rgya che gzigs pa po// yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po// spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras// rgyal chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod// rgyal ba'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes ltar// bstan dang bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyongs// mchod rten gtsug lag khang rnams dang*// skye dgu ma lus bde bar bsrung*// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// zhes sogs brjod/ phyogs skyong bcu la/ oṃ da sha dikra lo pā la sa pa ri bā ra a kā ro sogs kyis phul la/ dbang po me lha gshin rje dang*// bden bral chu bdag rlung gi lha// gnod sbyin dbang ldan tshangs pa che// sa bdag 'khor dang bcas la bstod// rgyal ba'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes ltar// bstan dang bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyongs// mchod rten gtsug lag khang rnams dang*// skye dgu ma lus bde bar bsrung*// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ zhes sogs brjod/ 'khor du gtogs pa'i 'byung po rnams la/ de ba nā ga yakṣa sogs kyi mthar/ a kā ro btags la gtor ma bsngo/ 'khor du gtogs pa'i sde brgyad po// mi dang mi min 'byung po'i tshogs// sa'am bar snang gnas bcas pa'i// byang sems ldan pa thams cad la// mchod pa 'bul zhing phyag kyang 'tshal// 'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur tam// sogs shlo ka gcig brjod do// tshar grangs mang po'i skabs snga ma rnams su tshig bcas kho nas mchod bstod phrin bcol bya/

gtor 'bul 'di rnams rjes ma kho nar tshar gcig gis chog go /gsum pa sdig bshags ni/ khams gsum 'gro lnga skye gnas bzhi// 'khor ba'i rgyud du gtogs kun dang*// rigs mthun skyes pa bdag cag gis// dug gsum dbang gis sgo gsum nas// las dang nyon mongs skye ba'i rgyu// mtshams med lnga dang nye ba lnga// mi dge bcu dang log pa bzhi// sgrib pa rnams dang kun sbyor dang*// de yi rgyu dang 'bras bu dang*// yun ring 'khor zhing mi khom brgyad// mtho ris thar pa'i lam 'gog cing*// bdag dang gzhan la yongs gdung ba'i// kha na ma tho ci bgyis pa// chos dbyings phyogs bcu dus gsum dang*// rigs rnams kun la rab bzhugs pa'i// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la// ma lus bshags shing sdom par bgyi//

bzhi pa rjes su yi rang ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras bcas dang*// rang rgyal nyan thos thams cad dang*// 'gro kun bsod nams ye shes kyi// rgyu dang 'bras bu thams cad dang*// sems bskyed lam zhugs mchog thob pa// de dag kun la yi rang zhing*// bsam dang sbyor ba dag pa yis// 'gro ba kun la bde slad du// 'khor gsum dag pa'i tshul gyis bsgrub// lnga pa chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten snang mdzad pa// bde gshegs sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// byang chub rim par sangs rgyas te// bskul ba'i don la gzhes rnams la// tshangs pa 'dra bar tshul bsgyur te// rim gro gus pa mchog bskyed cing*// thal mo sbyar bas rab btud de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// drug pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rab 'byams na// bde gshegs bdud bzhi nges bcom zhing*// 'gro don sangs rgyas mdzad pa mdzad// mya ngan 'da' ston bzhed rnams la// thal mo sbyar ba rab btud de// 'gro ba kun la phan pa'i phyir// chos dbyings brtan pa'i lugs bzhin du// mya ngan mi 'da' g.yung drung sku// stug po bkod pa'i bdag nyid rnams// bskal pa'i mthar yang bzhugs par gsol// bdun pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/ brgyad pa sems bskyed rjes 'brel dang bcas pa ni/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang rgyal ba'i sras// dpang gyur spyan gyur tshad mar gyur// 'gro don mdzad par dbang gyur pa// byang chub blo mnga' dgongs su gsol// ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal ba dang*// rgyal sras dpa' bo de dag gis// 'gro ba phan dang bde slad du// byang chub snying por bzhugs bzhugs su// dngos po kun dang bral ba dang*// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnams spangs pa// bdag med chos kyi bdag nyid kyis// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong nyid rang bzhin thugs bskyed ltar// bdag dang rigs mthun gzhan gyis kyang*// bla med byang chub sems bskyed bgyi//

zhes lan gsum dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*// 'phags pa kun gyi thugs rje dang*// chos nyid dag pa'i mthu dang ni// bsam dang sbyor ba dag pa yis// khams gsum rgyud lnga skye gnas bzhi// gzugs can gzugs can ma yin dang*// 'du shes med dang yod min dang*// sems can rigs rnams ji snyed pas// so so'i skye bor gtogs pa'i sa// sdug bsngal thams cad myur spangs te// 'phags lam bde ba mya ngan 'das// nges par legs pa rtogs gyur cig /'phags lam brnyes pa thams cad kyis// gong ma'i yon tan mchog thob cing*// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi// bde ba dag la gzhol gyur cig / ces shis pa brjod/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gshegs pa yi// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis// bsod nams dang ni ye shes tshogs// sems can kun la bstabs mkhyen ltar// bdag dang sems can kun gyis kyang*// rang gi bsod nams ma lus pa// rdzogs sangs rgyas bde ma thob bar// sems can rnams dang 'phags tshogs la// de dag rab tu bstab par bgyi// zhes bsod nams gzhan la bstab bo/ dgu pa bsngo ba ni/ bla ma'i bla ma dkon mchog dang*// mchod rten khyad par 'khor bcas la// 'dis mtshon dge ba ci bsags pa// des ni sems can thams cad dang*// 'phags pa'i skye bo'i tshogs kun gyis// ye shes pa yi lam gyi mchog /'jug dang gnas dang 'phar ba dang*// spyod pa nyid kyi yul rnams ni// go rim bzhin du rab rtogs te// sku gsum mkhyen bzhi'i tshogs rdzogs shing*// bla med sangs rgyas 'grub par smon// bcu pa skabs don la gnang ba zhu ba ni/ 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad dgongs su gsol lo// bdag cag rnams dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i rjes su 'jug cing slob te/ srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba rnams bla na med pa'i bde ba la 'god par dam bcas nas deng 'dir mchod pa'i tshogs mchog gis brgyan pa'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor bshams te/

'phags pa rnams gdan 'dzoms par spyan drangs nas/ kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba/ ('phags pa 'od zer dri med rnam par dag pa ) de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dang dam tshig la rnam par blta ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs bklag cing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku'i mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad (dgu bcu rtsa dgu ) tshul bzhin du btab cing mchod/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde dang gzungs zab cing rgya che ba bklag cing mchod de gdan 'dzoms pa chen po'i gleng gzhir gsol nas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod la sogs te 'gro ba mang po'i mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du gsol zhing mchis na/ 'phags pa rnams kyi smon lam khyad par can dang*/ thugs dam bzang po'i dbang du mdzad nas sems can skyabs su gsol ba rnams la thugs brtse bar dgongs te bdag cag rnams kyis theg pa chen po'i mdo sde dang gzungs zab cing rgya che ba rnams bklags shing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos sku'i mchod rten bgyi ba'i cho ga gzugs brnyan tsam zhig bgyis pa 'dir gleng gzhir mdzad nas/ mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gdan 'dzoms pa chen po mdzad de/ mchod pa bzhes shing*/ ji ltar sngon cho ga gang*/ tshul gang gis byin gyis brlabs te mdzad pa bzhin du/ deng yang cho ga yongs su rdzogs par mdzad de byin gyis brlab cing chos kyi de kho na nyid gtan la dbab pa la sogs te thabs mkhas pa'i sgo sna tshogs nas/ 'phags pa thams cad kyi rnam par thar pa'i sgo yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang*/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang gnod pa thams cad rgyu dang bcas pa byang zhing zhi ba dang*/ phan pa dang bde ba bla na med pa 'phral du thob par 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab cing*/ ji ltar 'tshal ba yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i dngos grub dam pa stsol bar ci gnang*/

sngon lha'i bu nor bu'i snying po dri ma med pa la (sngon bram ze chen po ser skya'i zla ba la ) rjes su thugs brtse bas/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis dpal gyi mgul nas phan yon ji ltar gsungs pa de thams cad bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyis 'phral du thob cing mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab par ci gnang*/ gzungs 'di nyid phyag mtshan du bzhes pa la sogs te 'phags pa chos skyong ba thams cad kyis kyang ston pas bka' gtad cing so so nas zhal gyis bzhes pa ltar ji skad gsungs pa'i phan yon thams cad bdag sogs sems cad thams cad kyis 'phral du thob par byin gyis brlab par ci gnang*/ ci nas kyang dkon mchog gsum gyi sku mi nges pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa dang bdag cag rnams kyi ngag mi sun/ 'jig rten gyis smad par mi 'gyur ba'i tshul du mthu dang phan yon mngon du bstan par ci gnang*/ zhes brjod pas/ ji ltar gsol bzhin 'phags pa rnams kyis phrin las mdzad cing 'gro don du 'gyur bar bden pa bdar zhing yid kyis bsngo ba ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mthu dang byin gyis brlab dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs dang*/ 'phags pa sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa ma dag pa mi mnga' ba rnams kyi thugs dam nges pa'i bden pas/ rig sngags rgyal mo yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i tshul bzhin du chos kyi sku'i mchod rten btab ste/ mchod sprin rgya mtshos brgyan cing pho brang gi dkyil 'khor bshams pa 'dir phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang*/ chos skyong ba thams cad gdan 'dzom pa chen por mdzad de mchod pa bzhes shing*/ kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba'i gzungs dang*/ ('phags pa 'od zer dri med rnam par dag pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i gzungs dang*/)

chos kyi sku'i mchod rten rnams tshul bzhin du byin gyis brlabs par mdzad de/ mdo sde dang gzungs zab cing rgya che ba rnams so so'i cho ga yongs su rdzogs par bskangs te/ bdag sogs 'gro ba mang po'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad par gyur cig /chos sku'i mchod rten la yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che rig pa'i rgyal mo'i yig 'bru gser gyi mdog can phreng bar gnas pa dang*/ 'phags pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs las 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten thams cad du khyab cing 'phags pa rnams kyi sku la babs pas ni sgrib pa gnyis las grol zhing rnam par thar pa gong nas gong du 'phar te 'gro don spyod pa'i mthu dpag med thob cing*/ sems can thams cad kyi don la bskul bar gyur cig /'gro ba lnga'i sems can gyi lus la phog pas so so'i sdug bsngal dang sgrib pa thams cad bral zhing bde ba dang ldan par gyur la/ 'od zer gyi phung po'i nang nas 'phags pa gdan 'dzoms pa mthong nas skyabs su 'gro zhing byang chub tu sems bskyed nas ngan 'gro las thar te 'phags pa'i lam la 'jug par gyur cig /bdag cag rnams la khyab pas 'gro don dpag med sgrub nus pa'i mthu thob ste de bzhin gshegs pa dag dang sku gsung thugs mtshungs par gyur cig /yang 'od zer de dag gcig tu 'dus nas bum pa'i gzungs chab la khyab ste reg pa tsam gyis gnod pa dang*/ bkra mi shis pa mi bde ba thams cad zhi bar byed pa/ dpal dang bde legs skyed par byed pa'i bdud rtsi'i dag byed du gyur cig /bsgrub bya'i lus dang 'khor dang yo byad thams cad la khyab ste/ nad dang gnod pa thams cad bsal zhing zhi nas lus sems skyon thams cad dang bral ste rdo rje lta bur mkhregs shing brtan pa dang chos kyi snod du gyur cig /gzhan yang chos kyi de kho na nyid gtan la dbab pa la sogs pa thabs mkhas pa'i sgo sna tshogs pas 'phags pa thams cad 'gro ba ma lus pa'i don rdzogs par mdzad par gyur cig

/bdag cag rnams kyis sems kyi dmigs pa 'ga' bskyed pa dang*/ gzungs kyi tshig 'bru 'ga' brjod pa yang 'phags pa rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo sna tshogs dang*/ tshig 'bru mtha' yas par rdzogs shing rnam par dag par byin gyis brlab par gyur cig / lan gsum mam bsdu na gcig brjod/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mthu dang byin gyi rlabs dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs dang*/ 'phags pa rnams kyi thugs dam nges pa'i bden pas de bzhin du gyur cig / ces lan gsum brjod do// bcu gcig pa gzungs bzla ba ni/ 'phags pa rnams kyis gnang zhing phrin las mdzad de ji ltar bsngos pa bzhin mngon du 'gyur bar mos la/ dri med kyi gzungs mdo bklags shing*/ gzungs ring thung brgya rtsa brgyad re bzla/ mthar gzungs bzla bzhin du bum chus rang gzhan khrus bya zhing khong du btung*/ gzungs chab phyogs kun tu 'thor zhing*/ 'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhag gyur tam/ sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*// skye rgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*// nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog / brjod do// gsum pa mjug bsdu ba la brgyad/ bsags sbyong smon lam bskor mchod dang*/ bzod gsol gshegs bsngo bkra shis so// dang po slar yang bsags sbyong bya ba ni/ phyogs bcu dus gsum du bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ dam pa'i chos dang byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos dang*/ rang rgyal ba'i dge 'dun dang bcas pa dkon mchog bla na med pa thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcu na mchod rten sku gdung dang ring bsrel dang bcas pa thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa thams cad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa'i tshogs de dag thams cad la mchod yon dang dri chab/

bdug spos dang me tog /zhal zas dang mar me/ rol mo dang sil snyan/ gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pa dngos su ci 'byor pa 'di dag dang*/ phyogs bcu na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i lha rdzas dang*/ mi'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa ci mchis pa thams cad dang*/ gzungs dang rig pa'i mthu dang mos pa'i stobs kyis bskyed pa'i bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i chos kyi dbyings su gtogs pa thams cad rgyas par bkang ste dbul zhing mchod do// bdag cag gis thog ma ma mchis pa nas 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe rabs thams cad du sdig pa mi dge ba'i las mdor na mi bgyi bar rigs pa'i las ni bgyis bgyi bar 'os pa'i las ma bgyis pa la sogs pa dngos sdig ci mchis pa thams cad yang dag par 'chags so// dus gsum gyi 'phags pa dang skye bo'i dge ba mtha' dag gi bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo*// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul lo// 'jig rten gyi sgron me gang dag mya ngan 'da' ba'i tshul ston par bzhed pa de dag thams cad la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'jig rten gyi don mdzad cing yun ring du bzhugs par gsol bar 'tshal lo// bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa sogs dang*/ sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig sogs shlo ka re re brjod do// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar chos kyi sku'i mchod rten tshul bzhin byas te bsags sbyangs bgyis pa la sogs pa dge ba rlabs po che'i stobs kyis/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa mthar phyin par mdzad pa'i dgongs pa lhun gyis grub par gyur cig /pho brang gi dkyil 'khor thams cad du bzang po spyod pa'i mchod pa'i sprin rgyas pas klubs par gyur cig /dam pa'i chos rnam pa thams cad kyi sgo nas 'jig rten thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig

/byang chub sems dpa' dang rang rgyal dang nyan thos thams cad so so'i rnam par thar pa mthar phyin nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig /dam pa'i chos skyong ba thams cad kyang thugs dam rlabs po che yongs su rdzogs shing mthu stobs gzi byin rab tu 'phel ba dang sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du brnyes par gyur cig /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la phan 'dogs pa'i lha mgon thams cad lus sems la nyes pa'i skyon dang bral nas dpal dang yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyang sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa byang*/ sdug bsngal gnod pa thams cad zhi/ dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs nas myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig /dge ba 'dis mtshon te bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ci mchis pa'i stobs dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs dang*/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde dang gzungs zab cing rgya che ba rnams mchod de bklags nas/ chos kyi sku'i mchod rten tshul bzhin bgyis pa'i bsod nams dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i stobs kyis mdo sde dang gzungs las phan yon ji skad bka' stsal pa thams cad bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag pos 'phral du thob cing yongs su rdzogs nas mngon du gyur cig /bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis thog ma ma mchis pa'i 'khor ba nas las dang nyon mongs pa dang rnam par smin pa'i sgrib pa la sogs pas/ ngan song gsum dang mi khom pa rnams su skye bar 'gyur ba'am/ byang chub kyi sems dang dge ba'i phyogs las nyams pa la sogs pa sdig pa'i las ci mchis pa thams cad la ma lus par bsal te gtan nas zhi zhing byang bar gyur cig

/sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad dang*/ tshe thung ba dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ mi dge ba dang*/ bkra mi shis pa dang*/ ngan pa dang*/ sdig to bgrang ba thams cad zhi zhing gtan du mi 'byung bar gyur cig /gdon bgegs kyi gnod pa las grol zhing de dag byams pa'i sems dang ldan nas phyin chad su la'ang gnod sems mi 'byung bar gyur cig /tshe ring zhing nad ma mchis pa dang*/ 'byor ba phun sum tshogs la bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa la sogs pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal thams cad dang ldan par gyur cig /tshe rabs thams cad du yang byang chub kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i lus dang longs spyod 'khor grogs bshes gnyen phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /theg pa chen po chos dang rtag tu 'phrad cig thos bsam sgom pa'i sgo nas don mngon sum du bgyid par gyur cig /dam pa'i chos ma nor bar ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams dang rgyun du 'grogs shing mnyes par byed pa dang*/ yo byad la ma chags shing thabs la mkhas pa dang shes rab kyi mthu thogs pa med pa dang ldan te byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che thams cad bde blag tu nyams 'og tu chud par gyur cig /bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa g.yung drung gi sku sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang chen po myur du thob nas sems can thams cad srid pa'i rgya mtsho las sgrol zhing mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings la 'god par gyur cig /

gsum pa bskor ba bya ba'i thog mar/ na maḥn ba na ba tī nāṃ/ ta thā ga ta gaṃ gā nā di/ bā lu kā nāṃ/ ko ṭi ni yu ta sha ta sa ha srā ṇāṃ/ oṃ bo bo ri/ tsa ri ṇi tsa ri/ mo ri go ri tsa la bā ri swā hā/ zhes dang*/ na mo bha ga ba te ratna ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ ratne ratne ma hā ratne ratna bi dza ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags gnyis lan bdun nam gsum brjod/ de nas dri med kyi gzungs ring thung gnyis ka'am mi shes na snying po gzungs thung bzla bzhin du bskor ba brgya rtsa brgyad bya'o// mthar nus shing spro na mchod rten bskor ba'i tshigs bcad dang gsal rgyal gyi tshigs su bcad pa dag bklag dgos kyi tshar grangs lta bu lcogs dka' bas/ mkhas pa gang dag rab tu sems dang zhing*// sangs rgyas mchod rten dag la gom 'dor na/ 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi srang tshad ni// stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa yin// ces dang*/ ye dharmā tsam brjod do/ / bzhi pa ni/ mchod pa dri med yongs dag pa// rnam mang rgya che thams cad dang*// so so'i mnga' ba rgya chen du// 'os pa bde bar sbyar ba 'bul// zhes pas mchod cing rol mo bya'o// lnga pa ni/ 'phags pa gdan 'dzoms pa chen po dgongs su gsol/ deng 'dir 'phags pa rnams spyan drangs te bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams kyi don mdzad par gsol ba'i skabs 'dir/ bdag cag dus ngan pa'i sems can spyod pa dman zhing ma dag pas 'gal 'khrul nongs par gyur pa'i ci mchis pa thams cad mthol bshags bzod par gsol na thugs brtse bar dgongs te bzod par bzhes nas 'phral dang yun du sgrib par mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab par ci gnang*/ drug pa ni/ oṃ// khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs brjod pa'am/ yang na ring bsrel snying po can gyi rten la dmigs te brtan bzhugs spyi mthun byas kyang rung ngo*// bdun pa ni/

'phags pa'i sku gdung rin chen ring bsrel snod// rnying bcos byi dor bgyis shing mchod pa dang*// gsar brtsigs mchod cing khrus chab gsol ba dang*// bstod dang bskor dang gus pa bgyis pa dang*// smon lam zab mo sems yid dang btab pa'i// byin rlabs yon tan khyad par chen po'i mthus// bdag cag yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa dang*// dad mos grogs byed rjes su yi rangs rnams// smon lam mthu stobs khyad par chen po yis// dang ba'i yid kyis mchod rten 'di brtsigs pas// deng nas bdag cag sdig sgrib byang gyur te// bla med byang chub bdag cag myur thob shog / brgyad pa ni/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs sam/ ston mchog dam pa sogs sam/ che ba'i che mchog sogs zhal nas gsungs pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa gang rung brjod la/ rol mo bsgrag cing me tog gi char dbab par bya'o// sā tstsha khri 'bum la sogs 'debs pa'i tshe/ cho ga med na phan yon byin rlabs chung*// rgyas 'bring lan grangs mang po lcogs dka' zhing*// bsdus pa 'ga' yang rang bzor sbyar bar mthong*// des na cho ga tshar mang btang ba la// phan pa'i sems kyis gzhung dang mchod 'bum gyi// snying por bsdus kyang byis blos nongs pa kun// mchog gsum spyan sngar bshags so tshangs pa stsol// rgyal bas che thang bsngags pa'i chos tshul 'di// dzam gling kun tu rgyas pas lus can kun// gnas skabs mthar thug dge legs dpal gyis 'byor// mi gnas byang chub chen po mngon byed shog /ces pa 'di'ang gdan sa chen po dpal spungs su lo bstar sā tstsha mang po rgyun sgrub kyi srol dbon sprul rin po che nas btsugs pa sogs la shin tu nyer mkhor gyur pa dang*/ dad 'byor ldan pa gnyer mgon 'grub nas dri med khang brtsegs mchod rten ring bsrel 'bum phrag gi snying po can gsar bzhengs skabs snga phyir don gnyer chen pos bskul ngor/

mang thos kyi dge sbyong karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'am/ blo gros mtha' yas kyis rdzong sar bkra shis lha rtse'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// rgyal bas lung bstan 'jam mgon bla ma'i gsung*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten sgrub pa'i tshul// 'di yang mgon 'grub 'byor ba'i dpal las bskrun// dge bas 'gro kun bde gshegs nyid gyur cig /sarba dā ka lyā ṇāṃ bha ba tu/
